name: Exp_Karpenko
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom 'Karpenko' indicator, which uses a 144-period MA with historical analysis. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position management is handled through the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin mode options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Karpenko'指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标使用144周期均线和历史数据分析。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损止盈水平。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种保证金模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于Karpenko自定义指标的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是指标线与信号线的交叉判断。入场条件：当指标线从下方穿越信号线向上时触发买入信号（BUY_Open），当指标线从上方穿越信号线向下时触发卖出信号（SELL_Open），交叉判断需要前一根K线的指标关系满足条件且当前K线确认穿越。出场条件包括止损和止盈（默认SL=1000点，TP=2000点），同时支持反向信号平仓——当出现卖出信号时自动平掉多头仓位，反之亦然。仓位管理方面，EA支持五种保证金模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除浮亏后的自由保证金比例、扣除浮亏后的余额比例以及固定手数模式。默认使用固定手数0.1手。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，并通过Recount标志在数据不足时重新计算。策略运行在H4周期上，使用144周期MA作为基础参数，历史回溯500根K线。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy based on the custom Karpenko indicator, with core logic centered on crossover detection between the indicator line and signal line. Entry conditions: a buy signal (BUY_Open) is triggered when the indicator line crosses above the signal line from below, while a sell signal (SELL_Open) fires when the indicator line crosses below the signal line from above; crossover confirmation requires the previous bar's indicator relationship to satisfy the condition and the current bar to confirm the crossover. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus opposite-signal closing where a sell signal automatically closes long positions and vice versa. Position sizing supports five margin modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size, defaulting to 0.1 lots fixed. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and employs a Recount flag to trigger recalculation when insufficient data is available. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe using a 144-period MA as the base parameter with 500 bars of historical lookback.

parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/扣浮亏自由保证金/扣浮亏余额/固定手数）

pros: 使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线重复开仓，逻辑严谨
支持五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
反向信号自动平仓功能提供额外的出场保护
止损止盈参数可配置，默认TP大于SL体现良好的盈亏比设计
可独立控制买入/卖出的开仓和平仓开关，灵活性强
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries on the same bar, ensuring logic rigor
Five position sizing modes offer flexibility for different risk preferences
Opposite-signal auto-closing provides an additional exit protection layer
Configurable stop loss and take profit with default TP>SL reflecting good risk-reward ratio design
Independent on/off switches for buy/sell opening and closing provide high flexibility
cons: 依赖自定义Karpenko指标但未内嵌，指标缺失时EA无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能不适合所有品种和周期
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
没有移动止损或追踪止损功能，盈利后无法锁定浮动利润
信号仅基于单一指标交叉，缺乏多维度确认容易产生虚假信号
cons_en: Depends on external custom Karpenko indicator which is not embedded; EA fails to run if indicator is missing
Default SL=1000 and TP=2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments and timeframes
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
No trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits after favorable moves
Signals rely solely on single indicator crossover, lacking multi-dimensional confirmation and prone to false signals
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，例如在H4信号基础上用日线趋势方向过滤，减少虚假信号
添加移动止损功能，在价格朝有利方向移动后自动收紧止损以锁定利润
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., filtering H4 signals with daily trend direction to reduce false signals
Implement a trailing stop feature that automatically tightens the stop loss as price moves favorably to lock in profits

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失时初始化失败但不会产生错误交易
默认止损止盈值较大，在波动性较低的品种上可能导致资金利用效率低
缺乏点差过滤，极端行情下滑点可能超过Deviation设定值导致成交失败
risk_points_en: Dependency on external custom indicator causes initialization failure but does not produce erroneous trades
Large default SL/TP values may lead to low capital efficiency on low-volatility instruments
No spread filter means slippage in extreme conditions may exceed Deviation setting causing order failure
